# Automated ROADMAP: full 12-week study plan
# Source of truth = schedule.json (generated by scripts/build_schedule.py).
# A GitHub Actions workflow opens one issue per day from schedule.json.

## Weeks
1. **Cyber Fundamentals** — Linux/Windows, networking, AD, crypto/web, recon tools, web attack tools
2. **SOC** — SOC L1, log analysis, SIEM (Wazuh), IR, 5 investigations
3. **Pentest** — recon, web exploit, privesc, post-exploit, 10 CTF machines
4. **Azure Fundamentals** — cloud concepts, arch/services, management/governance, AZ-900
5. **Docker + Kubernetes** — containerize the stack, full K8s deploy
6. **ML + LLM** — ML crash course, transformers, local LLM, embeddings
7. **RAG** — vector stores, secure RAG platform (Portfolio Project 3)
8. **AI Agents** — agent course, build agents, upgrade AI Job Agent (flagship)
9. **DevSecOps + Azure Security** — CI/CD, SAST/scanning, fail-closed CI, Azure security
10. **AI Security + Sentinel** — MS AI security, OWASP LLM Top 10, attacking agents, Sentinel/KQL
11. **Projects** — AI SOC Analyst (flagship), AI Security Lab
12. **HTB + Launch** — HTB reset, portfolio polish, CV/LinkedIn, interview, apply

## Portfolio projects (5, built across weeks)
1. Securely deployed FastAPI+Postgres+Azure API (W5-9)
2. K8s AI app (React+FastAPI+Postgres+Redis+AI) (W5-6)
3. Secure RAG platform (W7)
4. **AI SOC Analyst — flagship** (W11)
5. AI Security Lab (W11)

## How to regenerate
```bash
python3 scripts/build_schedule.py   # writes schedule.json (72 days)
```
